column1: #mapping_set_description: DESCRIPTION file (DCF) of a built BSgenome data package, as shipped in the source tarball on bioconductor.org. Holds the standard R package fields plus the seed's genome fields (organism, common_name or species, genome or provider_version, provider, release_date, source_url).

column9: Lossy: Older packages put the common name (Yeast) in a field called species.
Value transformed (date). Lossy: Free text; only YYYY/MM/DD values convert. Others stay in extras.
Lossy: Often a download directory, not one file.
